note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The parts of a case file's route map are taken apart: the starting resolution, the end card of each supplied route, the filter clip and the calendar (a fixture only). Only the supplied relationships are drawn; a plain relation has no arrowhead and nothing is causal unless supplied. Each end card finally shows the state it was supplied with; no finality doctrine, and nothing says whether a route is closed or available. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels and traversalOrder are editable.
